Test Case Title: TC0001_Check for a paperflite user without access to hey sales tries login
Description: Validate paperflite user without access to hey sales should not be able to login
Precondition: User is a valid paperflite user but has no HeySales access
Steps:
1. Launch the app
2. Enter valid PF credentials (no hey sales access)
3. Tap Login
4. Check the UI in no permission page
Expected Result:
1. Login screen should be displayed.
2. Credentials should be accepted in the input fields.
3. “No Permission” page should be displayed with "You don't have permission to this application" and Back button.
4. The UI elements in the No permission page should match with the UI screens
Actual Result: Paperflite user without access to hey sales is not able to login
